cases.name: Strict schemas discard unknown top-level and nested fields
cases.expected: Unknown fields cannot persist through normal model writes

cases.name: Profile allowlist preserves identity and security flags
cases.expected: Profile update cannot change phone, active/verified flags, device tokens or operator updates

cases.name: Nested preference updates merge siblings and strip unknown keys
cases.expected: Allowed toggle persists without unexpected keys or erasing sibling preferences

cases.name: Public profile and populated sender exclude phone/device credentials
cases.expected: Public responses omit phone and fcmTokens while retaining authorized profile data

cases.name: Default model reads/serialization hide sensitive fields
cases.expected: Defense in depth: default model read and JSON omit device tokens and OTP hashes

cases.name: Operator-shaped body target cannot create a DM
cases.expected: Object-shaped identity input rejected without new channel or request

cases.name: Bracket query input cannot broaden notification ownership
cases.expected: Real Express query parsing preserves fixed owner filter and does not execute bracket operators

cases.name: Malformed ObjectId and cursor reject without writes
cases.expected: Invalid route ID/cursor returns controlled denial and leaves domain data unchanged

cases.name: Concurrent phone insertion is constrained by actual unique index
cases.expected: Exactly one insert succeeds and duplicate receives MongoDB 11000

cases.name: Concurrent invite insertion is constrained by actual unique index
cases.expected: Exactly one space can hold the same inviteCode

cases.name: Canonical DM key serializes concurrent atomic upserts
cases.expected: Canonical pair order and partial unique index produce one pair channel

cases.name: Pending request pair duplicates are constrained at data layer
cases.expected: Defense in depth: duplicate active request pair cannot persist

cases.name: OTP creator persists bcrypt only and removes raw input
cases.expected: Persisted hash matches synthetic code and raw OTP field is absent

cases.name: Expired OTP denied before physical TTL deletion
cases.expected: Verifier excludes an expired record still present in MongoDB

cases.name: OTP attempt cap and sequential consumption preserve single use
cases.expected: Third wrong attempt exhausts code; valid code deletes record and cannot replay

cases.name: OTP replacement invalidates previous unconsumed record
cases.expected: New OTP marks old record used and only newest code verifies

cases.name: Actual OTP and notification TTL indexes match expiry field
cases.expected: Both collections have expiresAt ascending TTL with expireAfterSeconds zero

cases.name: Expired notification excluded before asynchronous TTL cleanup
cases.expected: Policy candidate: expired inbox item is not served or counted while awaiting TTL deletion

cases.name: Soft deletion blanks content and reactions on persisted message
cases.expected: Save deletion hook blanks text/media and records deletion timestamp

cases.name: Editing a deleted message cannot restore stored text
cases.expected: Deleted message update is denied and placeholder content remains unchanged

cases.name: Deletion removes denormalized quote and channel text copies
cases.expected: Policy candidate: delete scrubs copied previews as well as original content

cases.name: Stale private-channel membership cannot bypass removed space membership
cases.expected: After owner removes member, REST message read denies despite stale channel array

cases.name: Inactive space blocks protected channel read
cases.expected: Policy candidate: inactive space membership cannot authorize channel data

cases.name: Missing resource references are rejected at model boundary
cases.expected: Defense in depth: required ObjectId refs must point to existing related resources

cases.name: Routed acknowledgement rejects oversized note and preserves state
cases.expected: Route-level validation compensates for update validators omitted in controller

cases.name: Deactivated and deleted user records invalidate fresh HTTP credentials
cases.expected: HTTP authentication consults live user state rather than trusting JWT alone

cases.name: Notification writes bind ID and owner and preserve foreign record
cases.expected: Foreign notification read/delete denied; own update succeeds

cases.name: Support write derives identity and status from authenticated user
cases.expected: Caller cannot mass assign support owner, phone or triage state

cases.name: FCM instance method deduplicates and caps device tokens
cases.expected: Seven sequential registrations persist latest five distinct tokens

cases.name: Device token cannot remain bound to two accounts
cases.expected: Policy candidate: device token registration has a defined account-transfer boundary

cases.name: Socket availability write enforces schema note limit
cases.expected: Socket update rejects oversized note without persisting invalid availability
